description: This source file implements certificate path building logic, including path iteration, issuer selection, and path validation within a certificate verification framework.

classes.name: IssuerEntry
classes.description: Represents a certificate and its trust level, used during issuer selection.

classes.name: CertIssuersIter
classes.description: Iterates through potential issuer certificates for a given certificate, supporting synchronous and asynchronous issuer retrieval.

classes.name: CertIssuerIterPath
classes.description: Tracks the current path of certificates during path building, preventing duplicates.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a certificate path and its trust status, with validation methods.

classes.name: CertPathIter
classes.description: Generates possible certificate paths from a target certificate to a trust anchor.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building and validating certificate paths, managing path iteration and result collection.

methods.name: FingerPrintParsedCertificate
methods.description: Computes a hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: CertDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string for a certificate, including fingerprint and subject.

methods.name: PathDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string for a list of certificates.

methods.name: CalculateKeyIdentifierMatch
methods.description: Determines if the authority key identifier matches the subject key identifier between issuer and target certificates.

methods.name: TrustAndKeyIdentifierMatchToOrder
methods.description: Assigns a priority order to issuer certificates based on trust level and key identifier matching.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::GetNextIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the next candidate issuer certificate.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::AddIssuers
methods.description: Adds new issuer certificates to the iteration list, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::SortRemainingIssuers
methods.description: Sorts remaining issuer candidates by priority.

methods.name: CertPathIter::GetNextPath
methods.description: Generates the next possible certificate path, handling depth, iteration limits, and backtracking.

methods.name: CertPathBuilder::Run
methods.description: Executes the path building process, verifying paths and collecting results.

methods.name: CertPathBuilder::AddResultPath
methods.description: Adds a path result to the collection, updating the best path if applicable.
